== Biography ==
William Glasgow appears in Ireland, National Army Census, 1922: Birth Date: abt 1900; Attestation Date: 5 Aug 1922; Attestation Place: Greencastle Donegal.<ref name="anc1">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/62515/records/145 Ireland, National Army Census, 1922 — William Glasgow]. Ancestry search-result index row, saved and reviewed 4 November 2026; Irish Military Archives original not inspected.</ref>

William Glasgow was christened on 22 May 1901 at St. George's Church, Everton, Lancashire, England; parents Robert James Glasgow and Emma. This entry is attributed to the same person as a consolidated, compatible record (child christened).<ref name="anc143844682">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/143844682 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975, William Glasgow, 22 May 1901, St. George's Church, Everton, Lancashire, England]. Index entry read 2026-11-05; original uninspected.</ref>
